readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, at the dinner, when her husband had the guests hold up their watches
When the guests held up their watches to her husband at the temple's nine strike (Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine)
The temple struck ten while she and the doctor were playing piquet in the salon
A moment after the doctor came back from fetching his cigars, the hall clock struck eleven

durations: From the temple striking nine to the temple striking ten: one hour (implied by the two strikes)
From the doctor's return to the hall clock striking eleven: "a moment after" (unquantified)
From Madame Monnier sitting down at the piano to the doctor's return: "until he came back" (length not stated)
whereabouts: Madame Monnier's husband (Aurèle) gave the dinner
Guests at the dinner, including Félix and Monsieur Girard, were at the table when the temple struck nine and watches were held up
Aurèle scolded Félix at the dinner table
Aurèle and Monsieur Girard quarrelled at dinner
Madame Monnier and the doctor played piquet in the salon after dinner
The doctor (apparently Casimir Vauthier) left the cards to go out and fetch his cigars
The doctor asked Madame Monnier to play for him as he went out
Madame Monnier sat down at the piano at once and played Chopin until the doctor came back
Madame Monnier stopped playing when the doctor came in
